verdict.rationale: The evidence shows bizfile requires entity-linked User Access accounts for online filings. It never documents the sign-in or identity-verification method: nothing about credential MFA, biometric liveness, in-person visits, or mailed PINs. Without a documented remote credential-MFA sign-in path, this applicable identity axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
